decisions.rationale: All 184 comparators were reviewed. The listed neighbors also separate GUI, runtime, and owner authority, but they govern different surfaces or lifecycle envelopes rather than this page action boundary.

All comparators were checked; terminal security, identity privacy, and evidence redaction are adjacent controls, but none owns the container-host URL, assignment lifetime, and post-termination state boundary together.

The listed privacy gaps concern terminal identity, evidence, or watchdog snapshots; none governs durable account-pressure and account-switch history across retention, deletion, export, and pseudonymization.
